commands.title: Update Ryoku
commands.description: Installs the latest Ryoku packages or channel commits, redeploys the desktop, and reloads the shell.

commands.title: Update the whole system
commands.description: Updates Ryoku and the base distribution together. Package changes can require a password and may need a reboot.

commands.title: Wait for an update build
commands.description: Waits for the channel build or source check to finish before updating.

commands.title: Force an update past its gate
commands.description: Updates even while a build or source check is still in progress. The channel may not be ready yet.

commands.title: Show full update output
commands.description: Runs the update while streaming the complete package and deployment output.

commands.title: Start a Hub update job
commands.description: Starts the background update job controlled by Ryoku Hub.

commands.title: Feed update authentication
commands.description: Provides authentication input to a background update job.

commands.title: Cancel a background update
commands.description: Cancels the update job started for Ryoku Hub.

commands.title: Check for Ryoku updates
commands.description: Shows the active channel, installed and latest versions, pending changes, and snapshot count.

commands.title: Read update status as JSON
commands.description: Prints the same channel and update status as machine-readable JSON.

commands.title: Show the Ryoku version
commands.description: Prints the installed Ryoku release and commit.

commands.title: Show version and branch
commands.description: Prints the installed version with its tracked branch or channel.

commands.title: Show a decorated version
commands.description: Prints a human-friendly release name and version.

commands.title: Follow stable releases
commands.description: Switches this system to stable packaged Ryoku releases.

commands.title: Follow unstable source
commands.description: Switches this system to the unstable source lane and follows the development branch.

commands.title: Follow a tagged release
commands.description: Switches this system to a frozen tagged Ryoku package build.

commands.title: Build stable from source
commands.description: Tracks stable while building from a local checkout instead of packaged artifacts.

commands.title: Roll back to an earlier release
commands.description: Lists release and snapshot restore choices. Applying a choice downgrades the system or changes the next boot.

commands.title: Roll back to a release
commands.description: Downgrades Ryoku to the named release. Newer package and configuration changes can be lost.

commands.title: Prepare a snapshot restore
commands.description: Guides a whole-system snapshot restore through the boot menu. Work created after that snapshot can be lost.

commands.title: List system snapshots
commands.description: Lists available Snapper snapshots and their restore identifiers.

commands.title: Run last-resort recovery
commands.description: Resets a broken source checkout to the main branch and redeploys it. Uncommitted checkout changes can be lost.

commands.title: Install shipped configuration
commands.description: Lays the packaged Ryoku configuration into the current user's config directory.

commands.title: Reset all Ryoku customizations
commands.description: Asks for confirmation, then removes user overrides and rematerializes Ryoku defaults.

commands.title: Reset one Ryoku customization
commands.description: Asks for confirmation, then removes the selected override and rematerializes its default.

commands.title: Explain a config owner
commands.description: Shows which layer owns a configuration path and where it should be edited.

commands.title: Read config ownership as JSON
commands.description: Prints ownership details for a configuration path as JSON.

commands.title: Map all config ownership
commands.description: Prints Ryoku's generated configuration ownership map.

commands.title: Build a development checkout
commands.description: Builds and materializes Ryoku from a development checkout. It is not an installed-system update path.

commands.title: Repair common Ryoku problems
commands.description: Checks the system and applies safe automatic repairs. Some repairs may ask for a password.

commands.title: Check without repairing
commands.description: Reports problems without changing the system.

commands.title: Show every doctor check
commands.description: Includes passed checks and advisory notes as well as problems.

commands.title: Save a diagnostic report
commands.description: Writes a shareable diagnostic report to the chosen file.

commands.title: Explain doctor findings
commands.description: Sends the diagnostic report to the configured cloud model for a plain-language explanation.

commands.title: Read doctor findings as JSON
commands.description: Prints diagnostic findings as machine-readable JSON.

commands.title: Verify the installed release
commands.description: Reports whether this machine matches the release served by its current channel.

commands.title: Verify the release as JSON
commands.description: Prints the installed-versus-release comparison as JSON.

commands.title: Collect a debug bundle
commands.description: Prints a shareable diagnostic bundle with system state and recent relevant errors.

commands.title: Reload the desktop shell
commands.description: Restarts the Ryoku shell and asks the active compositor to reload its configuration.

commands.title: Create a bar plugin
commands.description: Creates a new bar plugin project with a manifest and Git repository.

commands.title: Create a bar plugin
commands.description: Creates a new bar plugin with its manifest and source template.

commands.title: Create a popout plugin
commands.description: Creates a new frame-popout plugin project.

commands.title: Create a sidebar plugin
commands.description: Creates a new sidebar-card plugin project.

commands.title: Name a new plugin project
commands.description: Creates a plugin project with explicit metadata in the chosen directory.

commands.title: Install a plugin
commands.description: Fetches or reads a plugin, validates and audits it, then installs it. Review code from sources you do not trust.

commands.title: Install a bar plugin
commands.description: Installs a plugin into the bar host after validation and audit.

commands.title: Install a plugin unattended
commands.description: Installs a validated plugin without interactive confirmation.

commands.title: Install despite audit findings
commands.description: Installs a plugin even when its audit reports findings. Unsafe plugin code can control desktop surfaces.

commands.title: Remove an installed plugin
commands.description: Uninstalls a plugin and removes its saved placement.

commands.title: List installed plugins
commands.description: Lists every installed shell plugin.

commands.title: List plugins as JSON
commands.description: Prints installed plugin metadata as JSON.

commands.title: Validate a plugin tree
commands.description: Checks a local plugin manifest, files, hosts, and entry points without installing it.

commands.title: Export a plugin for sharing
commands.description: Creates a validated distributable copy of an installed plugin.

commands.title: Share a plugin through Ryostore
commands.description: Prepares and submits a Ryostore catalogue contribution for the plugin.

commands.title: Check the login keyring
commands.description: Shows the configured keyring mode and whether the keyring is ready.

commands.title: Read keyring status as JSON
commands.description: Prints keyring configuration and state as JSON.

commands.title: Initialize the login keyring
commands.description: Records the first-login mode and seeds an unlocked blank keyring.

commands.title: Change keyring unlock policy
commands.description: Changes when the desktop keyring unlocks and whether applications may prompt.

commands.title: Convert the existing keyring
commands.description: Converts the existing keyring to the selected policy, reading passwords from standard input.

commands.title: Reset the login keyring
commands.description: Backs up and recreates the keyring. Stored application secrets may need to be entered again.

commands.title: Wire keyring login policy
commands.description: Rewrites the display manager's PAM keyring wiring for the selected mode.

commands.title: Check security-key setup
commands.description: Shows enrolled FIDO2 keys and the authentication policy they protect.

commands.title: Read security-key status as JSON
commands.description: Prints security-key enrollment and wiring as JSON.

commands.title: Enroll a security key
commands.description: Adds the inserted FIDO2 or U2F key to this user's authentication file.

commands.title: Remove a security key
commands.description: Removes one enrolled key by its one-based identifier. Removing the wrong key can block expected authentication.

commands.title: Remove every security key
commands.description: Deletes every enrolled security key from this user's authentication file.

commands.title: Protect an authentication target
commands.description: Enables or disables security-key authentication for the selected system target.

commands.title: Choose key or MFA policy
commands.description: Chooses whether a key may replace a password or must be used with one.

commands.title: Require touching the key
commands.description: Changes whether authentication requires physical contact with the security key.

commands.title: Require the key PIN
commands.description: Changes whether supported keys require their authenticator PIN.

commands.title: Require key user verification
commands.description: Changes whether supported keys require built-in user verification.

commands.title: Apply security-key PAM wiring
commands.description: Rewrites PAM configuration for one security-key target. A bad policy can prevent authentication.

commands.title: Show keyboard layout layers
commands.description: Shows the desktop, greeter, console, and boot-image keyboard layouts.

commands.title: Read keyboard status as JSON
commands.description: Prints keyboard layout state and sources as JSON.

commands.title: Detect the recorded layout
commands.description: Finds the keyboard layout recorded on this machine and explains its source.

commands.title: Apply a keyboard layout
commands.description: Applies a layout to the greeter and console and rebuilds the boot image.

commands.title: Apply layout without boot rebuild
commands.description: Applies the greeter and console layout without rebuilding the boot image.

commands.title: Import an existing config
commands.description: Scans a config or dotfiles tree, resolves keybind conflicts, and applies the selected files.

commands.title: Import a dotfiles repository
commands.description: Clones a dotfiles repository and imports its supported configuration.

commands.title: Choose conflict ownership
commands.description: Imports configuration while resolving every keybind conflict in favor of the chosen side.

commands.title: Undo the last config import
commands.description: Restores files from the last import. Changes made after that import can be overwritten.

commands.title: Undo a chosen config import
commands.description: Restores files from a timestamped import record. Later changes can be overwritten.

commands.title: Show the active compositor
commands.description: Shows the detected provider, whether it is live, its capabilities, and workspace model.

commands.title: Read compositor capabilities
commands.description: Prints the active provider's capability manifest as JSON.

commands.title: Check plugin compatibility
commands.description: Checks a plugin directory against the active compositor and prints a JSON verdict.

commands.title: Read desktop window state
commands.description: Prints the active provider's current workspaces, windows, focus, and outputs as JSON.

commands.title: Apply an output layout
commands.description: Applies and persists the neutral display layout stored in the named file.

commands.title: Print the session entry
commands.description: Prints the active provider's display-manager desktop entry.

commands.title: Print session IPC handles
commands.description: Prints the environment variables that identify the live compositor session.

commands.title: Show provider config ownership
commands.description: Prints a provider's config directory and owned files as JSON.

commands.title: List factory-reset paths
commands.description: Prints the provider configuration files a factory reset clears.

commands.title: Switch compositors
commands.description: Previews and switches to another compositor through a reversible package transaction.

commands.title: Switch and remove the old compositor
commands.description: Switches compositor packages and removes the previous variant. Returning later requires reinstalling it.

commands.title: Switch and keep the old compositor
commands.description: Switches to another compositor while leaving the current variant installed.

commands.title: Focus a window
commands.description: Focuses the window identified by the active provider's state frame.

commands.title: Close a window
commands.description: Closes the selected window through the active provider.

commands.title: Toggle window fullscreen
commands.description: Toggles fullscreen for the selected window.

commands.title: Toggle a floating window
commands.description: Switches the selected window between tiled and floating placement.

commands.title: Place a floating window
commands.description: Floats a window and sets its output-relative rectangle.

commands.title: Move a window to a workspace
commands.description: Moves the selected window to the named workspace and follows it.

commands.title: Summon a window by title
commands.description: Raises the newest exact-title match on the current workspace.

commands.title: Focus an app window
commands.description: Focuses a running window that belongs to the named application.

commands.title: Focus a workspace
commands.description: Changes to the workspace identified by a provider state frame.

commands.title: Cycle workspaces
commands.description: Moves forward or backward through the compositor's workspace order.

commands.title: Move a workspace to an output
commands.description: Moves the selected workspace and its windows to another output.

commands.title: Exit the desktop session
commands.description: Ends the active compositor session and returns to the login screen.

commands.title: Power displays on or off
commands.description: Changes display power through the active provider. Omitting an output can affect every screen.

commands.title: Cycle keyboard layouts
commands.description: Selects the next configured keyboard layout.

commands.title: Reapply the cursor theme
commands.description: Reapplies the configured cursor theme to the live compositor.

commands.title: Refresh window border colours
commands.description: Updates live window border colours when they follow the wallpaper palette.

commands.title: Turn night light on
commands.description: Starts the compositor's night-light backend at the requested colour temperature.

commands.title: Turn night light off
commands.description: Stops the compositor's night-light backend and restores normal gamma.

commands.title: Control the touchpad
commands.description: Changes or reports the touchpad state through the active provider.

commands.title: Cycle display arrangements
commands.description: Steps to the next saved display arrangement.

commands.title: Enable or disable an output
commands.description: Turns one named display connector on or off.

commands.title: Hide a window in scratch space
commands.description: Moves a window into the provider's hidden scratch workspace.

commands.title: Toggle scratch space
commands.description: Shows or hides the provider's special scratch workspace.

commands.title: Reload compositor configuration
commands.description: Reloads the active compositor's generated configuration.

commands.title: Enter a keybind submap
commands.description: Activates a named temporary keybind map.

commands.title: Leave a keybind submap
commands.description: Returns to the normal keybind map.

commands.title: Control automatic config reload
commands.description: Temporarily enables or disables automatic compositor config reload.

commands.title: Set the live cursor theme
commands.description: Changes the live compositor cursor theme and size.

commands.title: Set a screen shader
commands.description: Applies a configured screen shader, or clears it when no name is given.

commands.title: Change pointer focus mode
commands.description: Changes the live focus-follows-pointer mode and prints the previous value.

commands.title: Set a workspace layout
commands.description: Changes the tiling layout assigned to one workspace.

commands.title: Toggle compositor game mode
commands.description: Disables or restores expensive window decoration effects for gaming.

commands.title: Toggle the native overview
commands.description: Opens or closes the compositor's native window overview.

commands.title: Focus a directional window
commands.description: Focuses the nearest window in the requested direction.

commands.title: Focus an edge window
commands.description: Focuses the window at the requested horizontal edge.

commands.title: Move a window directionally
commands.description: Moves the focused window one step in the requested direction.

commands.title: Resize the focused window
commands.description: Resizes the focused window by one configured step.

commands.title: Cycle window heights
commands.description: Cycles the focused window through preset heights.

commands.title: Cycle window widths
commands.description: Cycles the focused window through preset widths.

commands.title: Center the focused window
commands.description: Centers the focused floating window on its output.

commands.title: Maximize the focused window
commands.description: Toggles maximized placement for the focused window.

commands.title: Move a window by workspace
commands.description: Moves the focused window forward or backward through workspace order.

commands.title: Focus a directional output
commands.description: Moves focus to the nearest output in the requested direction.

commands.title: Move a window to another output
commands.description: Moves the focused window to the neighboring output in that direction.

commands.title: Move a workspace to an output
commands.description: Moves the current workspace cell to the neighboring output.

commands.description: Opens the global application launcher on the active display.

commands.title: Open the window overview
commands.description: Opens Ryoku's overview for workspaces and windows.

commands.title: Open a plugin surface

commands.description: Opens visualizer placement mode.
